name: glm-conductor
description: Marketplace for the GLM semantic orchestration plugin: selective routing (solo/delegate/audit/full), Native Workflow execution compiled from canonical DAGs, minimal deterministic assurance (change_id freshness, ownership scope, repository writer guard, completion guard), and optional bounded quota resume

plugins.name: glm-conductor
plugins.description: Main-session (host model) architect with selective routing (Delegability x Assurance): delegated work compiles from a canonical DAG into ZCode Native Workflows, fresh-context read-only reviewers cover high-assurance routes, and minimal deterministic guarantees (change_id, ownership scope, writer guard, completion guard) plus optional user-authorized bounded quota resume keep delegated work verifiable and recoverable
